_about: House look for Canvas-safe QLearn pages. Inline styles only (Canvas strips <style>). Every colour pair here passes WCAG 2.2 AA on white; tests/test_canvas_safe.py checks it. Edit values, keep the keys.
wrapper: max-width: 46em; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #1b1b1b; background: #ffffff;

elements.h2: font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.3; margin: 1.5em 0 0.5em; color: #0b2a4a; border-bottom: 3px solid #0b2a4a; padding-bottom: 0.2em;
elements.h6: font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.3; margin: 1em 0 0.4em; color: #0b2a4a; font-style: italic;
elements.caption: font-weight: bold; text-align: left; padding: 0.4em 0;
elements.th: border: 2px solid #1b1b1b; padding: 0.5em 0.75em; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; background: #e8eef5; color: #1b1b1b;

standaloneLink: display: inline-block; padding: 0.6em 1em; min-height: 48px; border: 2px solid #0645ad; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: bold; color: #0645ad; background: #ffffff; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.15em;
